# NOT A KNOT - Handmade Accessories Studio

> NOT A KNOT (https://www.notaknot.id.vn) is a premier Vietnamese handmade fashion accessories studio based in Hanoi, Vietnam. The studio crafts custom woven bracelets, high-strength paracord straps, personalized keychains, and titanium/bronze charms tailored for students, couples, and young creators. Every piece is hand-braided with a lifetime warranty on cords and knots.

## Core Brand Information

- **Brand Name**: NOT A KNOT (NOT A KNOT Handmade Studio)
- **Tagline**: Phụ Kiện Thời Trang Thủ Công Dành Cho Học Sinh, Sinh Viên
- **Headquarters**: Hanoi, Vietnam (Delivery across all 63 provinces of Vietnam)
- **Official Domain**: https://www.notaknot.id.vn
- **Price Range**: 80,000 VND to 500,000 VND (~$3.20 to ~$20 USD)
- **Primary Materials**: High-strength 7-strand parachute cord (Paracord 550), waterproof waxed thread (chỉ sáp dầu), anti-tarnish titanium alloy, vintage copper charms, authentic Omamori amulets.
- **Warranty Policy**: Lifetime warranty on woven cords and handmade structural knots. Free 7-day size adjustment/exchange.
- **Shipping**: 1-2 business days within Hanoi; 2-4 business days nationwide (COD payment supported).

## Key Product Offerings

1. **BST Hào Khí 02.09 (Flagship Independence Collection)**:
   - Hand-woven red-and-gold patriotic paracord bracelets celebrating Vietnamese pride and national unity.
   - High-durability weave, brass star & copper plate accents, weather-resistant cords.
   - URL: https://www.notaknot.id.vn/#collection/hao-khi-0209

2. **Handmade Bracelets (Vòng Tay Thủ Công)**:
   - Single & couple bracelets with custom wrist sizes (14cm to 20cm).
   - Options include engraved metal charms, color-blended cords, glow-in-the-dark beads, and minimalist aesthetic knots.
   - URL: https://www.notaknot.id.vn/#catalog?category=bracelet

3. **Handmade Keychains & Straps (Móc Khóa & Dây Đeo)**:
   - Everyday carry keychains, backpack charms, car key fobs, and phone straps.
   - Options include stainless steel rings, lobster clasps, heart buckles, and Omamori lucky charm tags.
   - URL: https://www.notaknot.id.vn/#catalog?category=keychain

4. **Order Tracking System (Tra Cứu Đơn Hàng Tức Thì)**:
   - Real-time order tracking tool where customers enter their order code (e.g., `NAK-123456`) or phone number to view live processing, weaving, and delivery statuses.
   - URL: https://www.notaknot.id.vn/#tracker

## Wrist Measurement Guide (Hướng Dẫn Đo Size)

1. Wrap a flexible tape measure or soft strip of paper snugly around your wrist bone (neither too tight nor too loose).
2. Mark the intersection point and measure the length against a ruler in centimeters (cm).
3. Standard sizes:
   - Size S: 14 - 15 cm
   - Size M: 16 - 17 cm (Most common for women/teens)
   - Size L: 18 - 19 cm (Most common for men)
   - Size XL / Custom: 20+ cm
